fact: The Bank of Namibia directive of 31 March 2025 requires payment service providers to stop CMA low-value cross-border EFTs through SADC-RTGS by 31 March 2027 and to use the TCIB scheme from 1 April 2027.
title: Directive on the Regularisation of Cross-border Low-value Electronic Funds Transfers within the CMA (PSDIR-10)
